logger.doc:name: Generic Error Logger
logger.message:
#[%dw 2.0 output application/json var identifier = error.errorType.identifier default "" var namespace = error.errorType.namespace default ""
var httpStatus = if ( ["INVALID_INPUT", "BAD_REQUEST"] contains identifier ) 400 else if ( ["UNAUTHORIZED", "MUTUAL_AUTHENTICATION", "INVALID_SESSION_ID"] contains identifier ) 401 else if ( ["FORBIDDEN", "INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSION"] contains identifier ) 403 else if ( identifier == "NOT_FOUND" ) 404 else if ( identifier == "METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED" ) 405 else if ( identifier == "NOT_ACCEPTABLE" ) 406 else if ( identifier == "UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE" ) 415 else if ( identifier == "STREAM_MAXIMUM_SIZE_EXCEEDED" ) 413 else if ( ["TOO_MANY_REQUESTS", "LIMIT_EXCEEDED"] contains identifier ) 429 else if ( ["CONNECTIVITY", "BAD_GATEWAY", "COMMUNICATION", "INVALID_RESPONSE"] contains identifier ) 502 else if ( ["SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE", "UNAVAILABLE"] contains identifier ) 503 else if ( ["TIMEOUT", "GATEWAY_TIMEOUT", "RETRY_EXHAUSTED"] contains identifier ) 504 else 500
var errorMessage = if ( ["EMAIL", "SMTP"] contains namespace ) "An error occurred while sending email notification"
else if ( namespace == "APIKIT" ) "Request validation failed. Please check the request payload, query parameters, or URI parameters"
else if ( namespace == "HTTP" ) "Failed to process request due to downstream service error"
else if ( namespace == "VALIDATION" ) "Input validation failed for the request" else if ( ["JMS", "AMQP"] contains namespace ) "An error occurred while processing messages from the queue" else if ( namespace == "CONNECTIVITY" ) "Unable to connect to downstream system" else if ( namespace == "SECURITY" ) "Security validation failed" else if ( namespace == "PARSING" ) "Error while parsing request or response" else if ( namespace == "EXPRESSION" ) "Internal processing error occurred while evaluating the request" else "An unexpected error occurred while processing the request" --- { status: httpStatus, message: errorMessage, appName: p('app.name'), errors: [{ errorTitle: identifier, errorMessage: error.description default "", correlationId: correlationId }] }]
